Trail Technology · Unit 7: Electricity · Module 1

Introduction: The Electric Bike

How mechanics connects to the electrical systems on a modern bike.

Lesson coming

The question

What turns a battery’s charge into a push up the climb?

The physics

  • Electrical systems on a bike
  • Energy conversion
  • Mechanics and electricity

Learning objectives

  • Identify the electrical systems on a modern bike
  • Trace energy from battery to motor to wheel
  • Connect force, energy and power to their electrical versions

Helps to know first: Work and Power (Trail Physics).

The mountain biking connection

An e-bike’s battery stores energy, its controller and motor turn it into torque at the wheel, and lights, sensors and computers run on the same electricity.

Learning activities

Learning activities for this topic are being developed.

The skills above show what this topic covers. In the meantime, the Lab has standalone tools you can explore.
